title: BUGFIX — ScriptValidator hook check rejects 75% of bundles (standard + reaction templates have no 'hook' segment)
rationale: ScriptValidator.validate() always looks for a segment_name='hook' to check minimum length. Only listicle template has this segment. Standard template uses 'context'/'clip'/'commentary'/'insight'; reaction uses 'clip'/'reaction'/'insight'/'cta'. Both lack a named 'hook' segment, so !hookSeg is always true → 'Hook text too short (0 chars)' error → bundle rejected. With templates distributed 50% standard + 25% reaction + 25% listicle, ~75% of bundles are silently dropped before editing. Fix: make hook-segment check listicle-only. Standard and reaction templates skip the check.

tasks.description: In agents/scs001-script-validator/index.ts validate(): only enforce hook segment presence+length for listicle template. Standard and reaction templates have no 'hook' segment_name — skip the check for them.
